proposal.summary: The package test target would connect the existing catalog invariant assertions to the test workflow instead of printing a skipped-suite message. This would give CI behavioral evidence for duplicate, negative-stock and fractional-stock handling without duplicating assertions. Validation scope covers assertion discovery and CI failure propagation; restoring the prior package configuration is the rollback.
proposal.title: Catalog test target wiring

summary: The package test target is explicitly a skipped-suite message, while CI depends on that target and a separate visible test body contains assertions for catalog invariants. Connecting the existing suite addresses absent behavioral evidence in CI without duplicating assertions; validation remains unverified.
unverifiedChecks: Whether the package test target discovers the existing catalog assertions and reports failures to CI remains unverified.
